'''Dean and Lorana Jinzler's mother''' was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of four children, including [[Dean Jinzler|Dean]] and [[Lorana Jinzler|Lorana Jinzler]].

==Biography==
Jinzler and her [[Dean and Lorana Jinzler's father|husband]] were both maintenance engineers, who worked on the [[Technician/Legends|electronics maintenance]] and repairs in public areas inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She and her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] honored and adored the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Jinzler and her husband brought each of their four [[Jinzler family|children]] to the Temple so they could be tested for potential [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]]. To their joy, their third child, [[Lorana Jinzler|Lorana]] had high [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential and was accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the age of ten [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. However, Jedi were forbidden from knowing their families, in order to prevent attachments. As a result, Jinzler and her husband both were fired from their jobs as maintenance engineers in the Temple.<ref name="Outbound Flight"  />

Jinzler and her husband both found new, lower-paying jobs, which caused them to scramble in order to get their family packed and moved. Despite no longer working at the Temple, Jinzler and her husband continued to track their [[Gender/Legends|daughter's]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] in the Jedi Order through a friend of theirs who still worked in the Temple. The friend reported Lorana's progress as [[Jorus C'baoth]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to both Jinzler [[Parent/Legends|parents]]. Sometime later, Jinzler and her husband gave an [[Amethyst/Legends|amethyst]] to a group of [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizens]] who had at one [[Time/Legends|time]] been rescued by Lorana and C'baoth. Those citizens gave the amethyst to Lorana as a gift, without her knowledge that it was from her parents. The amethyst gem was used by Lorana, in conjunction with an [[activation stud]] to ignite her [[Lorana Jinzler's lightsaber|lightsaber]].<ref name="Outbound Flight"  />

Like Jinzler's first two children, her youngest child [[Dean Jinzler|Dean]] did not have high [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential. Jinzler and her husband still gave Dean the same love they gave their elder children. However, Dean misinterpreted their treatment of him. Jinzler and her husband set up a small shrine in their [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] home to honor Lorana. Whenever Dean got in trouble, they would reprimand him, telling him that Lorana would have never done the same action. Unfortunately for Jinzler and her husband, Dean's jealousy blinded him, and he eventually formed a profound hatred to Lorana and both of his [[Parent/Legends|parents]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="OF Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], take place in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> Lorana was amongst the fifty-eight [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] survivors of the [[Battle for Outbound Flight]]. After meeting [[Jorj Car'das]] onboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] remains, she ordered him to find Dean, and tell him to release his anger to Lorana and his parents.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> Forty-nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Survivor's date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' took place in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> a message was sent from Car'das to Dean, prompting him to join the [[Expedition to Outbound Flight|mission]] to the remains of ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', on a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] in [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]]. During Dean's visit to ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} remains, Dean discovered Lorana realize Lorana had [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] herself to save ''Outbound Flight's'' [[Survivors (Outbound Flight)|Survivors]]. As a result of his visit, Dean relinquished all the hatred he had developed towards Lorana and his parents.<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dean and Lorana Jinzler's mother was first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
